query.description: Unique identifier for account this API keys belongs to. AccountId is optional and if not provided it will default to the account making the request.
Name of this API Key.
Specify the API key response page you want to fetch, starting with 0. If not set, the response will contain first page. The highest allowed page value is 100.
The number of API keys in one response page. If not set, the response will be limited to 100 API keys, which is also the highest allowed size.
The ordering parameter of API keys in the response page. If not set, the API keys in the response will be ordered by API key id.
The order direction of API keys in the response page. If not set, the API keys in the response will be in the ascending order.
Is API key enabled.
Authentication key. Use this value for authentication on API. Keep this in secure storage and don't share it.

query.description: User's action. If nothing is provided, logs for all actions are returned.
Description of an action. If nothing is provided, logs for all descriptions are returned.

Date and time filter with the following format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`. If nothing is provided, there will be no lower limit filter applied on a date and time of recorded activity returned in logs.
Use it as a filter to apply to the action field to narrow down the logs returned. if nothing is provided, logs with all items are returned.
User's IP address. If nothing is provided, logs for all IP addresses are returned.
Max number of user activities returned in logs. Accepts values from `1` to `10000`. Defaults to `10000`.

Date and time filter with the following format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`. If nothing is provided, there will be no upper limit filter applied on a date and time of recorded user activity returned in logs.
User's key can be found on the user's profile page at the Infobip portal. If nothing is provided, the logs for all user keys are returned.
